content.title: Fiserv’s Only Bear Is a 26-Year-Old Analyst Who Beat Wall Street
content.summary: For a large chunk of Wall Street, the fintech’s massive earnings miss was a surprise: Nearly 80% of the analysts covering Fiserv had buy-equivalent ratings as of earlier this week.  On Wednesday, his skepticism was rewarded when the company’s shares tumbled a record 44% — wiping out some $30 billion in market capitalization — after it slashed its full-year earnings guidance and said it won’t be able to deliver on previous promises to investors.  At ground-zero of Fiserv’s troubles was Clover, the flagship point-of-sale system that frustrated clients with its superfluous fees.
